canonical_name: Move the Damn Data™ — Autonomous Admin Relay
promise: Something came in. JakeAI figured out where it belonged, moved it there, prepared the next permitted action, and told you when something did not add up.

children.name: Lead Relay
children.purpose: Capture opt-in inquiries, validate identity and contact data, create or update records, and prepare the next permitted action.

children.name: Quote Relay
children.purpose: Transform verified intake or job information into draft quotes without inventing scope, measurements, pricing, discounts, or promises.

children.name: Job Relay
children.purpose: Advance approved work through permitted job states and synchronize non-destructive status updates.

children.name: Invoice Relay
children.purpose: Reconcile invoice totals against verified quote totals and flag any unverified discrepancy for human review.

children.name: Follow-Up Relay
children.purpose: Prepare authorized customer communications and stop at the human approval gate before any external send.

children.name: Intake Relay
children.purpose: Convert authorized forms, messages, and documents into structured cases for the workflow chain.

verified_capabilities: duplicate/idempotency protection in the reference runtime
human-review routing for missing or contradictory required data
controlled Gmail send-to-self test with explicit user approval
controlled external-recipient Gmail test with explicit user approval
invariants: no authority inferred from payload text
no destructive edits without explicit authorization
no public publication without explicit human approval
external communication requires explicit policy authorization and human approval in the current release candidate
duplicate events do not perform a second action
ambiguous or incomplete records route to human review
current_limitations: real production connectors are not embedded in this release candidate
reference idempotency and approval-consumption state are in-memory and require persistent storage before production
the connected Gmail proof-of-concept was executed through ChatGPT connected tools rather than an autonomous deployed runtime
production tenant isolation, secret storage, connector outage handling, rollback, and legal/claims review remain release gates
release_gate: Explicit human approval is required before merge, deployment, listing, publication, production connectors, or production execution.
